flatApi.rule: Root methods are limited to lifecycle, configuration, events and batching; commands belong to one domain.

stability.stable: Documented API covered by signature and semantic contract gates.
stability.experimental: Must live behind an explicit subpath or GridFeature until promoted.
stability.internal: Must not be exported from a package entry point.
